direction_as_read: One small positive 30 day trial of Rheum palmatum root extract on intestinal transit, dosed by rhein-equivalent content the labels do not print
summary: The labels print Turkey rhubarb root extract at 500 mg per serving, with no anthraquinone or rhein content and no printed purpose. One trial meets the rule: Rheum palmatum root extract at 12.5 mg or 25 mg per day of rhein-equivalent anthraquinones improved transit versus placebo in 39 analyzed middle-aged adults (36499011). Other rhubarb evidence found was formula, add-on hospital or kidney use.

population.description: 42 middle-aged adults randomized, 95% women, average 58 years, with infrequent bowel movements; 39 analyzed, 13 per group.

study_contexts.study_design: Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled three-arm trial, 30 days

outcomes.name: Intestinal transit (primary endpoint per full text), reported through stool frequency, consistency and perceived transit: improved in both rhubarb groups versus placebo
Perceived transit speed much or significantly improved: 92% at the higher dose, 62% at the lower dose, 23% on placebo
Butyrate-producing bacteria and short-chain fatty acids changed favourably

limitations: Dose is mg of anthraquinone derivatives expressed as rhein, not mg of extract; the extract amount isn't carried here. These labels print 500 mg of extract and no anthraquinone or rhein content, so the amount can't be matched.
Very small: 13 analyzed per group and mostly women.
Loose stools or diarrhea increased at the higher dose: on clinician_items.
Abstract read; open full text read only in the passages on design, dose, funding and primary outcome.
Drafted from the source by agent review (Claude) on 2026-11-04; not clinician reviewed.

dose.reported_regimen: Tablets of Rheum palmatum dry root extract supplying 12.5 mg or 25 mg per day of anthraquinone derivatives expressed as rhein, or maltodextrin placebo, for 30 days.

normalization.basis: Daily anthraquinone derivatives expressed as rhein, as printed in the source; not total extract and no conversion.
